title: Docker Compose Deep Dive
description: Multi-container orchestration with Docker Compose — services, volumes, networks, profiles, and health checks.

entries.label: Start All Services
entries.description: Start detached, rebuild images if Dockerfiles changed

entries.label: Stop and Remove
entries.description: Stop services, remove containers, networks, and named volumes

entries.label: View Logs (All)
entries.description: Follow combined logs from all services (last 50 lines)

entries.label: Logs (Single Service)
entries.description: Follow logs from only one specific service

entries.label: Restart Single Service
entries.description: Restart one service without affecting others

entries.label: Scale Service
entries.description: Run multiple instances of a service (horizontal scaling)

entries.label: Execute Command
entries.command: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres
entries.description: Run a command inside a running service container

entries.label: Environment File
entries.command:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  api:
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
entries.description: Load env vars from file and override specific ones inline

entries.label: Health Check
entries.command:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  api:
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'curl', '-f', 'http://localhost:8080/healthz']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
entries.description: Add health checks so dependent services wait for readiness

entries.label: Depends On (Healthy)
entries.command:
services:
  api:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
entries.description: Start api only after db passes its health check

entries.label: Profiles (Optional Services)
entries.command:
services:
  debug-ui:
    profiles: [debug]
# Start with: docker compose --profile debug up
entries.description: Group optional services under profiles — only start when explicitly requested
